molecular_identity: indexed complete component graphs; source atom correspondence; explicit stereo carriers and groups

radicals.radical_electrons: required nonnegative integer electron occupancy; includes the pair in an explicitly supplied singlet center; not a physical unpaired-electron measurement
radicals.spin_multiplicity: required nullable positive integer 2S+1; only explicitly supplied atom-local spin; null when unspecified; never inferred from electron count
radicals.reference: RDKit calculates electron occupancy; independent CTAB/CX source metadata preserves explicit spin assertions lost by RDKit; changed explicit electron counts are reference failures
radicals.migration: replaces the misleading unpaired_electrons name and radical spin labels with separately asserted electron occupancy and numeric source spin; neither measurement is dropped

model_writer: MOL model serialization: empty title, no SDF properties; source observations retained in reports

numeric_contract.dssp_omega_degrees: 16 * f32 epsilon * 180, for single-precision geometry versus Biopython vectors
numeric_contract.other: roundoff only; all raw differences retained; discrete fields exact

dssp: beta partner identities and Biopython CA-C-N-CA omega included; first model; original source bytes; polymer sequence label required but nullable for nonpolymer residues
coverage: source format determines applicability before evaluation; missing inputs, reference failures and implementation failures are distinct
